caption: The drawing features a section of a wooden surface with decorative floral and geometric patterns. The background is a dark brown wood grain, with a rectangular panel of lighter brown in the bottom left corner, bordered by a thin red line. Floral motifs in yellow, green, blue, and pink are spread around the brown area and the wood background, with green leaves and stems connecting the flowers. The flowers are stylized, with blue, yellow, and pink petals and dot-like yellow or blue centers. Near the top and right edges, parallel zig-zag lines in reddish-pink color create a border, and a white dotted line with blue dots runs vertically by the edge of the brown panel, forming a curved pattern that resembles stitching. The overall composition includes grouped flowers, curved stems, and geometric borders, emphasizing symmetry and decoration on the wood surface.
title: Stencilled Floor
